newsitem.title: USA: SEC probes Prudential's sale of escrow securities.
newsitem.headline: SEC probes Prudential's sale of escrow securities.

text.p: The SEC has subpoenaed Prudential Securities Inc. in connection with a broad federal probe of possible "yield burning" involving bond offerings by the state of Pennsylvania, the firm disclosed.
Yield burning refers to allegations that bond underwriters overcharge issuers for U.S. Treasury securities purchased on the open market and used in bond refinancing transactions.

"In May 1996, the Philadelphia District Office of the Securities and Exchange Commission subpoenaed certain documents concerning the sale of escrow securities," the firm said in response to a Florida county request for proposals.
Prudential said the securities were sold by Prudential to the state of Pennsylvania "in connection with a 1993 certificate of participation issuance."
"I can confirm that we have provided documents and will continue to provide any information they want," a Prudential spokesman said, referring to the SEC.
